trend.name: Miniature me cleans my profile
trend.note: AI-video trend (Oct 2026): a tiny version of the creator climbs out of their own profile picture and tidies, dusts and rearranges the profile grid like a little room.

templates.title: Miniature Alexander tidies the F.A Vision profile
templates.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video, 10 seconds, bright and cheerful, photoreal miniature style. Start on a phone screen showing the F.A Vision Enterprise TikTok profile (blue and red F.A Vision logo as the round profile picture, a grid of furniture photos below). A tiny, palm-sized version of the man in my reference photo, in a navy polo shirt, climbs out of the round F.A Vision logo, stretches, then hops down onto the grid. He dusts the photo tiles with a little feather duster, then carries a miniature grey-and-gold steel student desk and chair set onto the top tile and lines it up neatly, wiping the desk top with a cloth. He steps back, gives a thumbs up to the camera and points at the profile name. Soft daylight, shallow depth of field, smooth camera push-in. No text except the profile itself. No other brands or logos.
templates.caption_hint: Little me came to tidy the shop 🧹 Student desk & chair sets GH₵650 a set, GH₵640 each from 50. WhatsApp 057 264 6176.
